title: Rune-Jit Cooking Skill Data
description: JSON Schema for data/skills/cooking.yaml. Cooking diverges from the gathering schema (raw->cooked/burnt food map instead of trees/axes), so it has its own schema per the data-schemas.md independence rule. Validate with: python3 -c "import jsonschema, yaml, json; jsonschema.validate(yaml.safe_load(open('data/skills/cooking.yaml')), json.load(open('data/schemas/cooking-data.schema.json')))"

meta.description: Skill-level metadata consumed by the plugin at startup.

skill.description: OSRS skill enum name — must be COOKING for this file.

ticks_per_attempt.description: Game ticks per item cooked (1 tick = 0.6s). Cooking = 4.

cook_animation.description: Animation ID for the cooking action (verify from cache).

fire_object_ids.description: Object IDs that trigger raw-food-on-fire cooking. Populated post cache extraction.

range_object_ids.description: Range object IDs offering the 'Cook' option. Populated post cache extraction.

food.description: Map of food name -> cooking definition.

level_required.description: Minimum Cooking level to cook this food.

xp.description: Cooking XP awarded per successfully cooked item.

stop_burn_level_range.description: Cooking level at/above which this food no longer burns on a range.

stop_burn_level_fire.description: Cooking level at/above which this food no longer burns on a fire.

uses_gauntlets.description: Whether Cooking gauntlets reduce burn for this food (lobster/swordfish/shark).

gauntlets_stop_burn_level.description: Stop-burn level when wearing Cooking gauntlets (applies to uses_gauntlets foods).

wiki.description: Primary OSRS wiki page for this food.
